instruction:
Write ONLY the test file `tests/ledger/parse.examples.test.ts`: one test per example of `src/ledger/parse.ts` taken from docs/TASK.md, this instruction, in example order, each named "<Function> example <n>: <what>". Do not write or modify `src/ledger/parse.ts`: the author of the criterion is not the author of the code. vitest, stubs imported from `tests/helpers.ts`; TypeScript with `strict` on, ESM, no `any`.

The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), each named after the Function and the example number, e.g. "Parse Entry example 1".

Examples of Function Parse Entry:
1. given the line "rent 1200"; when parsed; then {name: "rent", cents: 1200}
2. given the line "x"; when parsed; then the error "no amount in line 1"

Data Entry: One ledger entry.
Schema:
{ name: string, cents: number }
acceptance:
D=/tmp/morph/parse-judge; mkdir -p $D; S=$(date +%s)-$$; L=$D/acc-$S.log
cp tests/ledger/parse.examples.test.ts $D/0-$S.ts 2>/dev/null
(
 set -e
 node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
 node_modules/.bin/eslint tests/ledger/parse.examples.test.ts
 node_modules/.bin/vitest run tests/ledger/parse.examples.test.ts --reporter=dot
 node_modules/.bin/vitest run --reporter=dot
) > $L 2>&1; rc=$?; cat $L; exit $rc

instruction:
Write ONLY the test file `tests/ledger/checks.examples.test.ts`: one test per example of `src/ledger/checks.ts` taken from docs/TASK.md, this instruction, in example order, each named "<Function> example <n>: <what>". Do not write or modify `src/ledger/checks.ts`: the author of the criterion is not the author of the code. vitest, stubs imported from `tests/helpers.ts`; TypeScript with `strict` on, ESM, no `any`.

The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), each named after the Function and the example number, e.g. "Sum Entries example 1".

Examples of Function Sum Entries:
1. given entries rent 1200 and food 300; when summed; then 1500 (ref: Exact Sums)

Examples of Function Check Ledger:
1. given lines "a 1", "b 2" and the total 3; when checked; then ok
2. given lines "a 1" and the total 2; when checked; then the error "total 2 does not match the sum 1"

Data Entry: One ledger entry.
Schema:
{ name: string, cents: number }

Callee Parse Entry: One line of text into an Entry.
Behaviour: Splits "<name> <cents>" at the last space; the cents are digits.

Preconditions a test's setup depends on:
- ledger · Sum Entries · every line is parsed first, else Parse Entry faults before the sum
- store · Save Ledger · the directory exists, else the write faults
acceptance:

instruction:
Write ONLY the test file `tests/test_save_ledger_examples.py`: one test per example of `store/save_ledger.py` taken from docs/TASK.md, this instruction, in example order, each test function named `test_<function>_example_<n>`. Do not write or modify `store/save_ledger.py`: the author of the criterion is not the author of the code. pytest, fixtures from `tests/conftest.py`; Python 3.10 or later, standard library only.

The examples below are the criterion, and you are its independent author: write one test per example (no fewer, no merging), each named after the Function and the example number, e.g. "Save Ledger example 1".

Examples of Function Save Ledger:
1. given the entry rent 1200; when saved; then the file holds "rent 1200\n"

Data Ledger File: A text file of entries.
Schema:
{
  "path": "string",
  "text": "string"
}

Preconditions a test's setup depends on:
- store · Save Ledger · the directory exists, else the write faults
- ledger · Sum Entries · every line is parsed first, else Parse Entry faults before the sum
acceptance:

cp tests/test_save_ledger_examples.py $D/0-$S.py 2>/dev/null

 ruff check tests/test_save_ledger_examples.py
